HAVING COME UP FOR ADMISSION ON 07.11.2025, THE COURT ON THE SAME DAY PASSED THE FOLLOWING:
 Crl. M.C. No.7814 of 2025 -:3:
 2025:KER:84875  Dated this the 7th day of November, 2025  ORDER

The petitioners are the accused in C.C. No. 443/2018 on the file of the Court of the Judicial First Class Magistrate-II, Perinthalmanna ('Trial Court', for short), which has arisen from Crime No.
122/2016, registered by the Wandoor Police Station, alleging the commission of the offences under Sections 406, 420, 468 and 471 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code.

2. When the Crl.M.C came up for consideration on 06.10.2025, this Court, taking note of the fact that the final report was filed as early as on 02.05.2018 and the Crl.M.C was filed only on 25.08.2025, was not inclined to quash the final report due to the inordinate delay.

Consequently,
this Court had called for a report from the Trial Court to ascertain the reasonable time period that is required to dispose of the case.

3. By communication dated 29.10.2025, the Trial Court has informed this Court that the case was Shabeer K.T @ Muthu vs State Of Kerala on 7 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/178658455/

sentences.text:
Crl. M.C. No.7814 of 2025 -:4:
2025:KER:84875 protracted due to the Covid-19 pandemic and non- appearance of the accused and witnesses.

The Trial Court would dispose of C.C. No. 443/2018 within six months from 22.10.2025.
4.

On a consideration of the facts and the materials on record, particularly the communication of the Trial Court, I dispose of the Crl.M.C. by directing the Trial Court to consider and dispose of C.C. No.
443/2018, in accordance with law, as expeditiously as possible, at any rate on or before 20.04.2026.
Nonetheless, the personal appearance of the petitioners shall be dispensed with unless the Trial Court feels their presence is required.
